div.p: Connected Accounts: Email (via OAuth 2.0) and WhatsApp accounts linked to the Service by you.
Raw Communication Data: Unstructured emails, messages, and metadata passing through Connected Accounts before filtering.
Project Ledger: The timestamped online workspace where AI-generated project updates and summaries are stored.
Ledger Entries: Final summaries, action items, and milestone updates saved to a Project Ledger.
Summa Flow uses AI (including Google Gemini API) to scan connected communication streams, filter out irrelevant messages, and generate structured event timelines directly inside your Project Ledger.
Account Responsibility: You are responsible for maintaining account security and all activities under your credentials.

Authorization: By connecting an email or WhatsApp account, you warrant that you own or manage the account, have authority to process its data, and have obtained necessary consents from third parties you communicate with.
Password Security: We use secure OAuth tokens and APIs. We never view or store your passwords.
You agree not to use the Service for unlawful purposes, bypass platform security or AI filtering, or monitor communications without proper legal consent.
Ephemeral Processing: Raw Communication Data is processed in temporary memory (RAM). Non-relevant data is immediately destroyed and never written to storage.
AI Model Isolation: We never use your raw messages, metadata, or Ledger Entries to train public or third-party AI models.

Ledger Integrity: Disconnecting an account stops future syncing and deletes OAuth tokens. However, previously generated Ledger Entries remain in shared project workspaces to preserve historical project records for team members.

You retain full ownership of your raw communications and data. Summaflow LTD owns all platform architecture, software, UI design, and proprietary AI logic. We grant you a limited, non-exclusive, revocable license to use the Service during your subscription.
Paid subscriptions are billed according to your selected plan. All fees are non-refundable unless required by law. We will provide 30 days' notice prior to any price modifications.
AI Reliance: Summa Flow is a productivity tool, not an official legal or financial record. You are responsible for verifying critical deadlines and project terms before making business decisions.
Third-Party Dependencies: We rely on external APIs (Google, Microsoft, Meta) and are not liable for outages, sync delays, or service changes caused by these third-party providers.
Liability Cap: To the maximum extent permitted by Hong Kong law, our total liability for any claim is capped at the total amount paid by you to Summaflow LTD in the 12 months preceding the claim.
We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms or fail to pay subscription fees. Upon termination, API access tokens are permanently deleted.
These Terms are governed by the laws of Hong Kong. Any legal disputes shall be handled exclusively in Hong Kong courts.
